rationale: EO 11575 (Dec. 31, 1970) administered the Disaster Relief Act of 1970. EO 11749 (signed Dec. 10, 1973; 38 FR 34177, Wednesday, Dec. 12, 1973), Section 6(a), states that Executive Order Nos. 11526, 11575, 11662, and 11678, and section 1 of Executive Order No. 11725 are hereby superseded, and Section 6(b) makes the order effective thirty days after its issuance, that is January 9, 1974. EO 11749 re-delegates the disaster functions to the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, so it replaces rather than merely ends them. The OFR catalog agrees (Superseded by EO 11749, December 10, 1973). The order has no own-terms end; earlier endings: EO 11662 (1972-03-29) only amended it and EO 11725 (1973-06-27) transferred functions to HUD but did not end the whole order; partial scope: the supersession names EO 11575 in full. Savings: EO 11749 carries over the delegations and the Sec. 5 revocations in EO 11575 were performed in 1970. The status is no as of 2026-10-14; the lifecycle claim is blocked for the reasons in the decisions sheet.
